headline: BlackRock's chief executive Larry Fink said in a US television interview that he fears losing the AI race more than an AI bubble.
score_reason: Only a short video description was readable, so the quote itself is unchecked; lowered by 1.
importance_line: Investors hear one of the biggest fund managers weigh bubble fears against the risk of falling behind in AI.
summary: NBC News reports that its correspondent Christine Romans interviewed BlackRock chief executive Larry Fink on 6 Oct 2026 about a possible AI bubble and how to build the technology safely, on a day US markets closed at record highs. According to the report's headline, Fink said he fears losing the AI race more than a bubble.
notes: Only the video description was readable; Fink's words are not verified.
